recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Any future change to the general code system/value set concept wording should be a new Vocabulary WG decision rather than a residual FHIR-16379 application.
issue_request: FHIR-16379 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Vocabulary issue asking that CodeSystem and ValueSet definitions on the ValueSet and CodeSystem pages, including element definitions, be made consistent using the best of the definitions while deliberately retaining the implementer-facing enumeration terminology.
initial_application: The issue was applied by SVN revision 14665, represented in git as 5416ae07ff434eba9704b8e386269467de646e52, which changed both CodeSystem and ValueSet introduction pages to contain matching paired definition bullets.
additional_context: FHIR-39044 later resolved Published/Persuasive with Modification to remove those paired bullets from both pages because the CodeSystem wording was self-referential, and eeebf416097deebde5c14d8cd7cad63cfafc7868 applied that cleanup. FHIR-39051 resolved No Change, stating the CodeSystem page's linked HL7 v3 Core Principles reference supplies the code system concept definition.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current build-scope source keeps the same Core Principles framing on both pages and retains full authoritative resource/root definitions for CodeSystem and ValueSet in their StructureDefinition XML, while restoring the 2018 bullets would contradict FHIR-39044.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive-with-Modification issue removed the identical paired definition bullets introduced by FHIR-16379.
Resolved - No Change issue supports not adding another local CodeSystem concept definition because the Core Principles link supplies it.
